exposure: Antibiotic prophylaxis strategy for planned caesarean section (general routine vs. risk-based strategy)
cohort: The study included 7308 women in Sweden who gave birth by planned caesarean section from 37+0 weeks of gestation between 2014 and 2020.
finding: No significant difference was found in postpartum antibiotic prescription rates between hospitals with a general routine of prophylactic antibiotics for planned caesarean sections and those with a risk-based strategy.
